hooks.name: Update traceability on tasks save
hooks.description: When a spec's tasks.md changes, the agent refreshes the task, commit, test table in docs/KIRO.md with scripts/hooks/kiro-trace.ts.

action.prompt: A spec tasks.md was saved. Run `npx tsx scripts/hooks/kiro-trace.ts --write` to refresh the traceability table in docs/KIRO.md, then show the diff of docs/KIRO.md. The script only rewrites the block between the kiro-trace markers. Do not commit.
